note: Description taken from Holmgren's 1910 original description of Eutermes itapocuensis (in German), including the alate and soldier; the worker is not treated separately; type locality Jaraguá / Itapocú river system, Santa Catarina, Brazil. Holmgren uses the bimodal distribution of soldier head length in 131 heads as evidence of soldier dimorphism. The original is in German and the BHL scan OCR is only moderate: decimal points are often misread as commas or colons and some measurement digits are blurred; blurred values are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head capsule pale chestnut-brown, paler in front of the transverse band, with the muscle scars at the transverse band forming two large yellow spots that meet in the midline in front of the frontal marks; wing surface greyish yellow with a distinct lemon-yellow stripe (the subcostal stripe) below the radius sector; soldier head length shows two frequency peaks (1.55—1.60 and 1.75—1.80 mm), indicating soldier dimorphism.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule pale chestnut-brown, paler in front of the transverse band; postclypeus rusty yellow, antennae slightly darker rusty; thoracic nota yellow with brown edges; wings greyish yellow with a distinct lemon-yellow stripe close below the radius sector, this stripe separating from the radius sector before the middle of the wing; abdominal tergites brown, sternites yellow. Bristles of head and thorax rather sparse, abdominal sclerites more densely hairy, wing membrane finely hairy. Head broadly oval; compound eyes medium-sized, (rather) prominent; ocelli medium-sized, not far from the compound eyes; frontal marks triangular; transverse suture particularly clear; postclypeus short, only slightly longer than one quarter of its width. Antennae 15-segmented: segment 3 far longer than segment 2 but less than twice as long, often with a trace of division into two; segment 4 equal to segment 2 and slightly wider. Pronotum as wide as the head (without eyes), longer than half its width, anterior margin straight with a small median notch, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Media close to the cubitus, giving off 2—3 longer branches beyond the middle of the wing; cubitus with 6—8 branches, the inner 3—4 thickened. Measurements: head length 1.40—1.46 mm; from the anterior margin of the transverse band to the occiput 1.12 mm (the body length and head width figures are damaged in the OCR and are not cited).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, nasus brownish; body straw-yellow, the sclerites slightly darker. Head with only a few bristles; abdominal tergites not hairy, with only marginal bristle rows. Head broadly oval, nasus normal; frontal outline with a distinct elevation at the base of the nasus. Antennae 13-segmented: segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2, segment 5 equal to segment 2. Pronotum deeply saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Measurements: body length 3.5—4 mm; head length 1.45—1.95 mm, with frequency peaks at 1.55—1.60 mm and 1.75—1.80 mm; the head width figure is damaged in the OCR and is not cited.
